items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: He's brother. He's got a brother, Frank Connick. That bright fella. ... That's the only one I know, that's Frank.

ctx.x: There was a trombonist, Cornish. Was he with him then?
Oh yeah, that was all the band. That's what I kind of saw it out with. There was a trombonist and George, Louis, Louis. Frank Louis.
You mentioned you saw him once across the lake, you said just a few years ago.
